brand.name: SAFRA
brand.tagline: Stays across the Levant · from a single night

home.heroTitle: Your night in the Levant starts with SAFRA
home.heroSubtitle: Hotels, furnished apartments, villas, farms, chalets and camps
home.heroPromise: You pay SAFRA, and SAFRA follows your booking through to checkout. Your support and compensation are our responsibility, not the property's.
home.trustPayment: You pay SAFRA, never the property
home.trustCompensation: Automatic compensation when plans fall through
home.destinationsSubtitle: Cities that stay up with you
home.typesSubtitle: From a Damascene hotel to a camp under the stars
home.howSubtitle: Booking with SAFRA is not instant — and that is deliberate
home.howBody: You pay in full to SAFRA, and we contact the partner to confirm availability within two hours. If they do not confirm: a full refund plus compensation in your wallet.
home.pledgesSubtitle: Three commitments we do not compromise on
home.pledge1Title: Your relationship is with SAFRA, not the property
home.pledge1Body: Support, payment, complaints, changes and cancellation all go through SAFRA. No phone numbers before a booking is confirmed.
home.pledge2Body: No property is listed before SAFRA verifies its documents, photos and address. Look for the “Verified by SAFRA” badge.
home.pledge3Title: Compensation when we let you down
home.pledge3Body: If the partner does not respond in time: cancellation, a full refund, and compensation added to your wallet automatically.
home.partnersSubtitle: List your hotel or home on SAFRA
home.partnersBody: A free management dashboard, your calendar and prices in your hands, regular transfers, and only {rate} commission deducted from your payouts.

checkout.title: Complete your booking
checkout.subtitle: You pay SAFRA in full now · the booking becomes “pending confirmation” until the partner approves
checkout.noAccountNeeded: You can book without creating an account.
checkout.terms: By continuing you accept the cancellation policy and SAFRA's terms.
checkout.notInstant: Booking is not instant: after payment SAFRA contacts the partner to confirm availability within two hours. If they do not confirm, you are refunded in full and compensated in your wallet.
checkout.unavailable: This unit is not available for those dates.
checkout.unavailableHint: It may have just been booked. Try different dates.
checkout.datesTaken: Those dates were taken a moment ago. Please choose different dates.
checkout.cutoffClosed: Today's bookings have closed. The first available date is {date}.
checkout.networkError: Could not connect. Try again — this will not create a duplicate booking.
checkout.genericError: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.
checkout.walletCoversAll: Your balance covers this booking in full.
checkout.walletSignedOut: Sign in to use your SAFRA balance.

bookingPending.title: Paid — your booking is pending confirmation
bookingPending.body: SAFRA received your payment. We are contacting the partner to confirm availability.
bookingPending.step1: SAFRA contacts the partner to confirm availability within two hours.
bookingPending.step2: On approval you receive WhatsApp and email with your voucher and QR code.
bookingPending.step3: On arrival you use your booking reference or QR code with the partner.
bookingPending.guarantee: If the partner does not respond in time: the booking is cancelled, you are refunded in full, and compensation is added to your wallet automatically.

paymentReturn.title: Complete your payment by bank transfer
paymentReturn.intro: Your booking is held. To confirm it, transfer the amount below and quote the reference in the payment description.
paymentReturn.remittanceHint: Quote this on the transfer — without it the payment cannot be matched to your booking.
paymentReturn.nextSteps: Once the transfer arrives your booking is confirmed within one business day, and we email you.
paymentReturn.genericBody: This may take a moment. Please do not close this page.
paymentReturn.failedBody: Nothing was charged. Your dates are held for a short while — you can try again.

paymentMethods.heading: Payment method
paymentMethods.none: No online payment method is available yet. Our team will contact you to complete payment after booking.
paymentMethods.klarnaHint: Pay later or in instalments with Klarna
paymentMethods.cardHint: Your bank will verify the card (3-D Secure)

auth.signInSubtitle: Access your bookings and wallet balance.
auth.registerSubtitle: Book faster, and keep your wallet balance in one place.
auth.phoneHint: International format, so we can reach you about your stay.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Length matters more than symbols.
auth.guestNote: You can also book without an account.
auth.badCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.
auth.emailTaken: An account already exists for this email address.
auth.locked: This account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again shortly.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.networkError: We could not reach the server. Please try again.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.forgotSubtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new one.
auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link expires in an hour.
auth.resetSubtitle: This ends every other session on your account.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: Reset links expire after an hour and can be used once. Request a new one.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Sign in with it below.
auth.verified: Thank you — your address is confirmed.
auth.verifyFailed: Confirmation links expire after 24 hours and can be used once. You can request another from your account.
auth.claimedBookings: We also linked {count, plural, one {1 earlier booking} other {# earlier bookings}} made with this address to your account.
auth.verifyBanner: Confirm your email address to link earlier guest bookings and secure your account.
auth.checkEmailBody: If you did not have an account with this address, we have sent you a confirmation link. If you did, we have sent you a message explaining how to sign in or reset your password.

account.title: My account
account.walletHint: Applied at checkout on your next booking.
account.walletEmpty: You have no wallet balance yet. Compensation and refunds appear here.
account.noBookings: You have not booked a stay yet.
account.loadFailed: We could not load this right now. Please refresh.
account.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
account.walletGiftUnlinked: Gift cards are not linked to accounts yet
account.walletCombineNote: Both balances can be combined with any payment method in a single transaction (P-007).
account.notBuiltHeading: This section is not built yet
account.giftsNotBuilt: A gift card is redeemed by its code, and nothing yet links a card to your account — so a balance cannot be shown here without inventing one.
account.reviewsNone: You have not written a review yet.
account.favouritesNone: You have not saved a stay yet.
account.profileSaveFailed: Could not save. Check the details and try again.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Every session — including this one — was signed out, so please sign in again.
account.passwordWrong: Your current password is not correct.
account.passwordFailed: Could not change your password. Try again.
account.passwordRule: At least twelve characters, and different from your current one.
account.emailNotEditable: To change your email address, contact support: a change has to confirm the new address first.
account.invoicesIntro: A record of what you paid for each booking.
account.invoicesNotTax: These are payment records from SAFRA, not officially issued tax invoices. If you need a tax document, get in touch.
account.noInvoices: No invoices yet. One appears here after your first booking.
account.invoiceNoPayments: No payment attempts are recorded against this booking.
account.invoiceNotFound: No invoice with that reference in your account.

reviews.title: Review your stay
reviews.prompt: You stayed at {property}. Tell other travellers how it went.
reviews.bodyHint: At least three characters. Shown under your name to travellers and to the partner.
reviews.rule: A review cannot be edited or deleted once sent (P-006). The partner can reply to it.
reviews.notCompleted: You can review this once your stay has finished.
reviews.alreadyReviewed: You have already reviewed this stay.
reviews.hidden: SAFRA hid this review after reviewing a report from the partner. It stays in your record and is not shown to visitors.
reviews.failed: Could not send your review. Please try again.
reviews.none: No stays are waiting for your review.
